revisions.title: Property value reference: Compact efficiency
revisions.when: Approximate US$100,000–250,000 property-value or budget context; flexible design reference only.
revisions.principles: Prioritize useful shared living, short circulation, private sleeping rooms and durable repairable finishes. A modest sheltered threshold and simple coherent roof can carry the identity. Price alone determines neither floor area, bedrooms nor amenities. Avoid underdeveloped massing and unjustified scale; assess the actual household brief.
revisions.placement: Connect arrival to shared living and sheltered outdoor space; protect suite privacy from guest and service routes. Scale and spatial complexity follow programme and site capacity, not a price formula.
revisions.combinations: Compose with regional/style, room planning, entrance, facade, roof, materials and climate/site recipes. Waterfront entertaining may justify a pavilion, terraces or pool; urban sites may favor courts and privacy. Recreation, wellness, guest houses and garages are optional.
